previous_blocks: B01-B07 reference foundations validated before B08; no backport ownership transfer

authority.ground_truth: Only CoreRPG is authoritative; supplied accepted fixture facts are synthetic and unsigned
authority.networks: network_disruption_crisis_contract defines disrupted networks; B04 owns real capacities, transfers and stocks
authority.physical: B07 owns anomalies and physical hazard sources; B03 owns wars and armed conflict
authority.population: B01/B02 own demographic and sovereignty changes
authority.science: B06 owns scientific research; no automatic cures or technology improvements
authority.sessions: F11 and HOST independently enforce authority; B08 does not grant orders or credentials
authority.missions: B09 alone may derive mission candidates from accepted unmet needs, never from B08 projections
authority.scheduler: B10 owns autonomous background ticks and offscreen catch-up
authority.presentation: UE5/NAP/PADD display only observer-authorized, delivered, classified knowledge

facts.shock: Externally accepted campaign-scoped or canonical shock with real source tick, existing network, supported family and integer loss_bps 0..10000; positive to open crisis
facts.mitigation: Externally accepted same-crisis same-actor mitigation targeting an already shocked network; integer relief_bps 1..10000
facts.authorization: Separate accepted authorization for same actor/crisis/region/scope=intervene
facts.prime_directive: An intervened prewarp region must additionally have an accepted policy_review decision approved_exception; no self-grant
facts.recovery: Accept containment_report below residual pressure threshold, then independent recovery_report and zero remaining network exposure before close

propagation.direct: max accepted shock.loss_bps on each network minus min(10000,sum accepted relief_bps) clamped to zero
propagation.transitive: Max propagation through declared dependencies, floor(source_exposure * weight_bps / 10000), bounded to number of existing nodes
propagation.region: Max of network stress * existing criticality_bps / 10000 for a region
propagation.scope: Count existing exposed regions; galaxy-wide reach only if the preexisting graph supports it
propagation.status: Candidate risk exposure only, NEVER authoritative network capacity, lives, shortages or casualties
propagation.anti_amplification: Cycles and compound shocks do not create unbounded risk, matter or population; max model is conservative

lifecycle.containment: Accepted independent containment_report AND projected regional max pressure < 2500 bps; threshold is synthetic reference, not Trek canon
lifecycle.resolution: Previous contained state, accepted recovery_report, all_networks_restored=true, zero projected stress

knowledge.delivery: Verified sender/receiver and delayed arrival; PADD/NPC only see delivered snapshots, not ground_truth

replay.idempotency: same event ID + exact body accepted as no-op, changed body rejected
replay.ordering: tick >= cutoff and last committed tick
replay.record_digest: SHA256 deterministic JSON canonical event record, not a CoreRPG signature

forbidden: Generating crises, wars, disease organisms or catastrophes because a mission or player needs them
Changing CoreRPG inventories, population, ship damage, territorial borders, network routes or policy
Treating crisis projections as accepted humanitarian needs or issuing B09 missions
Rewriting protected canonical events, Omega, temporal history or existing wormhole topology
Granting access to prewarp worlds or information without validated independent permission
Publishing private information to PADD, NPC or AI before authorized delivery
runtime_gates: CoreRPG signed fact ingestion and WorldState-authoritative acceptance
